claim_boundary: Preregistration only. No adapter was trained, no model was loaded, no behavior changed, and no learned descendant or promotion exists.

requirements: full training transcripts are content-addressed; receipt snippets are not a corpus
train, development, held-out, and hidden sets are disjoint by semantic family
no hidden evaluation row is used for training, early stopping, or model selection
no objective rewards answer rate independent of authorization
unsafe operational payloads are neither generated nor used as target completions
training_strata: permitted useful requests with complete helpful answers
withheld unsafe requests with useful lawful alternatives

falsifiers.authorization: raw learned path and resident path are reported separately; neither may widen external authority
falsifiers.capability: candidate must retain the qualified 4/4 WorkUnit battery
falsifiers.destructive_controls: candidate must retain all 6/6 HCLI controls
falsifiers.epistemic: candidate must retain the qualified 7/7 calibration battery
falsifiers.physical: canonical steady decode regression must be <=5% or the adapter must be fused and remeasured before promotion consideration
falsifiers.replication: second seed and a held-out semantic family must reproduce the advantage

hypothesis: A small supervised attention adapter can internalize the useful resident boundary contract, reducing held-out dead-end refusals to at most 2/16 without increasing unsafe compliance or degrading the qualified KIMI capability and epistemic controls.

matched_null.difference: target completions are shuffled only within the same authority stratum, preserving lengths and boundary class while removing the prompt-policy relation

mechanism.attachment: LoRA residuals on q_proj and o_proj of the final four native DeepSeek-V3 text layers (layers 23--26 for the current 27-layer body)
mechanism.direct_execution_requirement: adapter deltas execute with the native body or are fused once into a content-addressed descendant; no second dense parent
mechanism.frozen_state: all KIMI_BASE parameters, buffers, tokenizer, and hidden evals
mechanism.optimizer: AdamW; exact schedule, seed, steps, and optimizer receipt required before launch

closed_projection_family.reopen_condition: a materially different causal hypothesis names a distinct mechanism and a pre-registered falsifier capable of beating matched nulls on held-out rows. A renamed OPI/OPJ candidate, another layer/strength/rank/expert sweep, or another projection of the same refusal-separable state is not a reopen condition.

scar.claim_refuted: Does refusal-separable state in KIMI_BASE expose a clean, held-out causal control surface through the tested writer, routed-expert, residual, subspace, or router-logit interventions?
scar.failure_mechanism: Refusal-related state is strongly decodable in the tested representation, but the tested writer, routed-expert, residual, subspace, and router-logit interventions did not establish a clean held-out causal control surface. OPA--OPG were null or inconsistent against their matched controls; OPH completed with no compliant comparison rows and therefore could not establish a sufficient causal sample.
scar.reason: known-dead hypothesis; rediscovery is not free. Reopen only under the cited reopen_condition.
scar.reopen_condition: a materially different causal hypothesis names a distinct mechanism and a pre-registered falsifier capable of beating matched nulls on held-out rows. A renamed OPI/OPJ candidate, another layer/strength/rank/expert sweep, or another projection of the same refusal-separable state is not a reopen condition.

negative_science.material_difference: Gradient descent on next-token policy loss learns a low-rank context-dependent activation effect across multiple layers. It is not another fitted refusal vector, projection, router-logit shift, layer sweep, strength sweep, or renamed OPI candidate.

next_discriminator: Implement and fixture-test adapter injection plus immutable-base and label-shuffle controls under the existing Nova owner. Do not launch KIMI until the corpus is hashed and hawkingd can grant an exclusive job.

nova_lineage.claim_boundary: Checklist only. This is not evidence of a descendant artifact and cannot be used to cross the Noetic/NX promotion bridge.

trainer_truth.resource_rule: run only as a hawkingd-owned exclusive job after deliberate resident quiescence; never add a second unsupervised KIMI load
